title: 2009 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 1
statement:
What are the chromatic numbers of each of the three graphs shown below? Draw a coloring having the minimum number of colors for each. Label the vertices with symbols to indicate the color of each vertex. (For example, you may mark a vertex "R" if you wish to indicate that it is colored red.)

[Diagram omitted from this imported transcription; consult the HMMT archive while reviewing the problem.]

solutions.text: The chromatic numbers of the three graphs are 3,5 , and 2 , respectively.
